Select the first 200 metabolism records for enzyme CYP1A2. Join metabolism to compound_structures on substrate_record_id to obtain canonical_smiles. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to obtain substrate compound name. Join metabolism to compound_records on drug_record_id to obtain parent compound name. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Sort by all returned columns ascending.
